sites.name: The Cairn Line on the Shoulder

sites.story: B15/B16: the road's nearest pass to the summit; cairns lead the eye to the mast
sites.layout: every ~40 m, alternating verges: a cairn of 4 stones; a cloth strip on the first
sites.notes: Replaces the road bible's cable-pole line (P25): the author ruled out poles and wires.
